deliverables.title: Quizzes (Best 6 of 8)
deliverables.notes: 8 quizzes total, best 6 counted. Online via WebAssign, asynchronous. Due dates posted on OWL. First quiz open during the week of Sept 16. The first 2 missed quizzes do not require academic consideration; additional missed quizzes beyond 2 may be reweighted to the final exam.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact due dates for all 8 quizzes are posted on OWL and not listed in the syllabus; only the first quiz's week is specified. Recurrence cadence inferred as roughly weekly.

deliverables.title: iClicker Lecture Participation
deliverables.notes: In-class participation via iClicker throughout the semester. Graded on % of questions answered (not correctness): ≥80% = 4/4; 70–79% = 3.2/4; 60–69% = 2.4/4; 50–59% = 2/4; 40–49% = 1.6/4; <40% = 0. Occasional missed classes are accounted for in the scheme. Long-term absences (3+ consecutive classes) supported by academic consideration will be adjusted.

deliverables.title: Midterm Test
deliverables.notes: In-person, 120 minutes (7:30pm–9:30pm). Covers course material from weeks 1–7 inclusive. Closed book; no calculators or electronic devices permitted. Mixture of short answer and multiple choice. Makeup midterm tentatively scheduled for Friday October 31st, 7:30–9:30pm.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: In-person, cumulative, 180 minutes. Scheduled by the Office of the Registrar during the exam period (December 11–22, 2025); exact date TBA. Closed book; no calculators or electronic devices permitted. Mixture of short answer and multiple choice.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact date and time not yet announced; listed as TBA in the syllabus.
